text:
deploy-bot: Attempting rollout for notifications-service chart@1.8.0 -> staging (canary=5%). Window check: CHANGE_WINDOW=23:00-02:00 UTC -> blocked.
nina: Wait, we scheduled this for earlier window. Why did CHANGE_WINDOW apply? I thought staging uses relaxed windows.
reza: Ops updated global change window last night to align with maintenance window. Staging inherited it via org-wide policy.
sylvie: During dry-run I noticed merged values set `notification.retry.backoff=0` which disables retry backoff — seems wrong for canary. helm diff snippet below:
```
--- values (current)
+++ values (proposed)
+notification:
+  retry:
+    backoff: 0  # unexpected, from chart default
```
release-manager: two issues: (1) blocked by change window; (2) suspicious values default. Decision needed: wait until window opens or patch staging override to set backoff to 100ms and run a limited smoke. Thoughts?
nina: If we wait, it pushes other releases behind. Patch seems lower risk if we keep canary at 1% and mute alerting.
reza: I prefer not to change staging semantics ad-hoc. Suggest pin staging to previous chart v1.7.9 for now and open an investigation.
infra-bot: Note: pin annotation workflow available. To pin run: `kubectl annotate helmrelease notifications-service redwood.releases/pinned=v1.7.9 -n staging --overwrite` Deploy-bot will honor it.
ci-bot: release-notes CI currently failing on this branch due to missing migration notes? Not relevant to chart bump but worth noting.
sylvie: The `backoff` key was introduced in 1.8.0 and defaulted to 0 by mistake. Chart author (pkg-team) already filed a patch but not released. We can either patch staging values or pin.
release-manager: quick vote: pin to v1.7.9 for staging and queue a follow-up to re-run 1.8.0 after chart patch and change-window alignment. Timebox 20m.
nina: +1 pin. I'll apply annotation and update release notes.
reza: +1 pin. Also set a temporary alert silence for notifications-service in staging to avoid noise.
infra-bot: Action checklist: [annotate pin, silence alerts, update notes].
nina: running annotate now:
```
kubectl annotate helmrelease notifications-service redwood.releases/pinned=v1.7.9 -n staging --overwrite
```
ndeploy: ack: pinned annotation detected, suspending automated promotion for notifications-service in staging.
ci-bot: Please add a changelog line: "staging pinned to v1.7.9 due to chart default introduced in 1.8.0 setting notification.retry.backoff=0; will reattempt after chart patch"
sylvie: I'll open chart PR with fix (pkg-team/helm-notifications#512) to set default backoff=100ms and add a test.
release-manager: schedule: pin now, wait for chart PR and infra change window sync, then unpin and promote. Add timeline in the release ticket.
reza: also add values-hash capture to the ticket for auditing: values-hash-before: f1b2c3
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-2037: ensure change-window inheritance for staging is explicit and add a test.
ci-bot: merge blocker note: release-notes PR needs a one-line entry.
nina: PR updated with one-liner and INFRA-2037 linked. CI passed.
release-manager: good. ops, please verify no side-effects from pin.
reza: staging pods stable with v1.7.9, health ok. I'll unpin only after chart v1.8.1 is released and window adjusted.
sylvie: chart PR opened and tagged patch release request. pkg-team will aim for v1.8.1 within 6 hours.
infra-bot: auto-reminder set: if v1.8.1 not released in 8h, re-evaluate risk.
release-manager: leaving thread open until unpin+promote. Add follow-up item to release retro: make helm-diff step fail pipeline when unknown new top-level keys are added by chart bumps.
(END)
